outcome: Pregnancy complications (threat of pregnancy interruption, edema, preeclampsia, gestational anemia, placental insufficiency with fetal growth retardation syndrome, intrahepatic cholestasis)
Childbirth complications (premature rupture of membranes, premature birth, fetal distress, Cesarean section rate)
Newborn condition (Apgar score, physical development, conjugation jaundice)
cohort: 351 women with HCV infection and 50 healthy pregnant women.
finding: Pregnant women with HCV infection experienced a significantly higher rate of pregnancy and childbirth complications, and their newborns had poorer outcomes compared to healthy pregnant women.
birth_weight: Mentioned as lower in the HCV-positive group
